acceptance: Converter unit tests per construct, plus a golden-file test on 5 real pages
Full docs/ converts with zero unknown-construct errors; the list of constructs handled is printed by site-build
All internal links in the converted output resolve (site_inventory diff: zero broken internal links)
No committed generated content; docs/ unchanged by the build
description:
Write a converter that runs inside site-build and reads docs/**/*.md as the canonical source (guardrail G-b). It writes Astro content-collection entries to a gitignored build directory.

Constructs to handle, with counts measured on 2026-10-03:
- {tags}: 219 → frontmatter tags
- {toctree}: 16 → sidebar config and section order
- note/tip/warning/important/deprecated admonitions: 26 → Callout component
- {ref}/{doc} roles: 18 → resolved relative links
- {mermaid}: 6 → build-time SVG
- MyST anchors and labels, image paths, code fences with Cobalt2-equivalent Shiki theme

Any directive, role or syntax it does not know is a hard build error naming file and line. Nothing is silently passed through.

Output is idempotent: a byte-identical rebuild from the same input.
